quests.instruction: Deliver the pitch before the lift opens.
quests.prompt: Pitch a reusable coffee cup with a built-in temperature display.
quests.correctAnswer: A small display on the side shows the exact moment your coffee is perfect to drink.
quests.hint: Focus on catching the ideal drinking moment, not the display technology.
quests.explanation: Pinpointing the ideal moment turns a small feature into a daily little pleasure.

quests.instruction: Deliver the pitch before the lift opens.
quests.prompt: Pitch a phone app that reminds you to stand up and stretch every hour.
quests.correctAnswer: Gentle hourly nudges keep your body moving and your energy up all day long.
quests.hint: Tie the reminder to energy, not just movement.
quests.explanation: Linking a small habit to energy levels gives the pitch an immediate personal payoff.

quests.instruction: Deliver the pitch before the lift opens.
quests.prompt: Pitch a noise-cancelling sleep headband designed for light sleepers.
quests.correctAnswer: Block out every disturbance, and fall asleep faster than you thought possible.
quests.hint: Describe the result - better sleep - rather than the noise-cancelling feature.
quests.explanation: Selling the outcome, not the feature, is instantly clear to anyone who sleeps poorly.

quests.instruction: Deliver the pitch before the lift opens.
quests.prompt: Pitch a grocery app that automatically tracks your weekly food spending.
quests.correctAnswer: Every trip is logged automatically, so you always know where your food budget goes.
quests.hint: Highlight the insight the app gives you, not just the tracking itself.
quests.explanation: Showing people exactly where their money goes creates value they can act on right away.

quests.instruction: Deliver the pitch before the lift opens.
quests.prompt: Pitch a GPS tracker designed specifically for outdoor cats.
quests.correctAnswer: Clip it to any collar, and always know exactly where your cat has wandered.
quests.hint: Speak to the peace of mind a worried owner wants.
quests.explanation: Pet safety is an emotional trigger that makes the product feel necessary, not optional.

quests.instruction: Deliver the pitch before the lift opens.
quests.prompt: Pitch a smart doorbell that recognises regular visitors automatically.
quests.correctAnswer: It learns familiar faces, so you get a name at the door instead of just a ring.
quests.hint: Pair convenience with a sense of security.
quests.explanation: Combining convenience with safety is one of the strongest pairings in home technology.

quests.instruction: Deliver the pitch before the lift opens.
quests.prompt: Pitch a compact single-serve blender that charges over USB.
quests.correctAnswer: Charge it like your phone, and blend a fresh smoothie absolutely anywhere.
quests.hint: Compare the charging method to something the listener already knows.
quests.explanation: A familiar comparison removes any learning curve from a new gadget.

quests.instruction: Deliver the pitch before the lift opens.
quests.prompt: Pitch a naturally flavored sparkling water with no added sugar.
quests.correctAnswer: It tastes like real fruit, with zero sugar and zero guilt in every sip.
quests.hint: Pair the taste with the health benefit in the same breath.
quests.explanation: Answering the 'does it actually taste good' doubt directly is what makes this pitch land.

quests.instruction: Deliver the pitch before the lift opens.
quests.prompt: Pitch a lunch container that keeps food hot for eight hours.
quests.correctAnswer: Your lunch stays hot until noon, so the microwave line is no longer your problem.
quests.hint: Focus on the hot meal, not on the insulation technology.
quests.explanation: Removing a daily annoyance - the microwave queue - is a strong, relatable hook.

quests.instruction: Deliver the pitch before the lift opens.
quests.prompt: Pitch a lightweight waterproof jacket that folds into its own pocket.
quests.correctAnswer: It folds into your palm, so you're always ready for rain without the bulk.
quests.hint: Focus on how small and ready it makes the user feel.
quests.explanation: Solving a common weather worry with something this compact is instantly relatable.

quests.instruction: Deliver the pitch before the lift opens.
quests.prompt: Pitch a gym bag with a UV light that removes odors overnight.
quests.correctAnswer: Overnight UV light keeps your gym bag smelling fresh, with zero extra effort.
quests.hint: Lead with the fresh result, not the UV technology.
quests.explanation: Fixing an embarrassing, common problem creates strong emotional pull toward the product.

quests.instruction: Deliver the pitch before the lift opens.
quests.prompt: Pitch smart socks that count your daily steps without any extra device.
quests.correctAnswer: No phone, no watch - just put them on, and every step still counts.
quests.hint: Emphasise what the user no longer needs to carry.
quests.explanation: Removing a device rather than adding one is a fresh, memorable angle.

quests.instruction: Deliver the pitch before the lift opens.
quests.prompt: Pitch a power strip that cuts standby power automatically when devices are idle.
quests.correctAnswer: It quietly cuts power to idle devices, saving you money without you lifting a finger.
quests.hint: Stress that the saving happens with zero effort.
quests.explanation: Effortless savings are one of the easiest benefits for any listener to want.

quests.instruction: Deliver the pitch before the lift opens.
quests.prompt: Pitch a wall-mounted herb garden with built-in grow lights.
quests.correctAnswer: Fresh basil and mint grow right on your wall, all year, with the lights built in.
quests.hint: Highlight fresh food at home in every season.
quests.explanation: Year-round fresh herbs appeal to cooks and plant lovers at the same time.

quests.instruction: Deliver the pitch before the lift opens.
quests.prompt: Pitch a sofa cushion that wirelessly charges your phone as you sit.
quests.correctAnswer: Just sit down, and your phone quietly charges - no cable, no thinking about it.
quests.hint: Make the charging feel invisible, not like a feature you have to use.
quests.explanation: Invisible convenience is one of the strongest hooks in everyday technology.

quests.instruction: Deliver the pitch before the lift opens.
quests.prompt: Pitch a multi-tool pen with a built-in ruler and phone stand.
quests.correctAnswer: One pen, three tools you already reach for, now built into a single device.
quests.hint: Count the tools out loud to show the value.
quests.explanation: Combining tools people already use removes any need to think it over.

quests.instruction: Deliver the pitch before the lift opens.
quests.prompt: Pitch a rechargeable flashlight that doubles as a phone power bank.
quests.correctAnswer: It lights your way and charges your phone the moment the power goes out.

quests.explanation: Framing a product around a real emergency moment makes it feel essential, not extra.

quests.instruction: Deliver the pitch before the lift opens.

quests.instruction: Deliver the pitch before the lift opens.

quests.instruction: Deliver the pitch before the lift opens.

quests.correctAnswer: Kids can call home and share their location, with absolutely no social media in sight.

quests.correctAnswer: Wash your clothes anywhere with just a sink and cold water - total independence.

quests.explanation: Independence is exactly what long-term backpackers value most in a small, simple product.
